name: Operational Data of an Energy Community Under P2P Trading and Flexibility Market Models
description: This dataset contains the annual input data used in the study “Statistical Analysis of an Energy Community's Operations in P2P Energy Trading and Flexibility Markets”. It includes hourly electricity demand, PV generation, thermal profiles, and DER configurations for 55 users in a low-voltage distribution network. The data supports the replication of optimization models analyzing peer-to-peer trading and flexibility services provision.
